assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1)
The patient presents with transient neurological symptoms suggestive of a transient cerebral ischemic attack (G45.9)

The service is ordered to correlate intermittent arrhythmic events with clinical symptoms and to assess for potential embolic sources or hemodynamic instability
The service directly supports the documented indication and the associated diagnoses of I47.1 and G45.9
